user.title: Add OXRS Touch Panel
user.description: Enter the panel's MQTT client id (shown on the panel's Settings screen).

data_description.hardware: Sets how many tiles each screen has. Pick the board named on the panel; if yours is not listed, keep the default.

confirm.description:
Do you want to add the panel "{name}"?

Board: {board}

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery message could not be parsed.
abort.not_oxrs_touchpanel: The discovered device is not an OXRS Touch Panel.

add_tile.title: Add a tile
add_tile.description: Choose which screen to add the tile to.

data.label: Label
data.sublabel_entity_id: Sub-label source (optional) - shows this entity's state under the tile
data.indicator_secondary_entity_id: Secondary sensor (optional, indicator tiles only) - shown alongside the primary value
data.album_art: Show album art as the tile background (transport tiles only) - replaces the play/pause icon

data_description.background_color: Leave on black for no colour of its own - the tile then follows its screen's colour.
data_description.larger: Next you choose from the sizes that fit at this position.

add_tile_playlists.title: Add a tile — choose playlists
add_tile_playlists.description: Tick up to {max} Music Assistant playlists. They appear in the tile's list on the panel, and choosing one replaces the player's queue with it.

edit_tile_details.title: Edit a tile — {type} (screen {screen})

data.label: Label
data.sublabel_entity_id: Sub-label source (optional) - shows this entity's state under the tile
data.indicator_secondary_entity_id: Secondary sensor (optional, indicator tiles only) - shown alongside the primary value
data.album_art: Show album art as the tile background (transport tiles only) - replaces the play/pause icon

data_description.entity_id: Changing the entity keeps everything else about the tile.
data_description.sublabel_entity_id: Clear the field to stop showing a sub-label.
data_description.background_color: Leave on black for no colour of its own - the tile then follows its screen's colour.
data_description.larger: Next you choose from the sizes that fit at this position.

edit_tile_details.description: Change anything below. The screen and the tile type can't change - to move a tile to another screen or change its type, remove it and add a new one.

edit_tile_playlists.title: Edit a tile — choose playlists
edit_tile_playlists.description: Tick up to {max} Music Assistant playlists. Choosing one on the panel replaces the player's queue with it.

edit_tile_background.title: Edit a tile — background image
edit_tile_background.description: Choose the background image for {tile}, or none. {images_available}.

name_screen.title: Name this screen
name_screen.description: Give screen {screen} a name, or keep the current one. This appears as the screen's label on the panel.

rename_screen.title: Screen name and colour
rename_screen.description: Choose the screen to rename or recolour.

screen_appearance.title: Screen {screen}: name and colour
screen_appearance.description: The name appears as the screen's label on the panel. Leave the colour on black to follow the panel-wide background colour.

data_description.screen_color: Black means no colour of its own. Tiles on this screen follow it unless they have a colour of their own.

add_background_image.title: Add background image
add_background_image.description: Generate a base64 image string using the OXRS Asset Generator at https://oxrs.io/tools/asset-generator.html then paste the imageBase64 value below. This image becomes available on every configured panel. Images must be under 4 KB and names cannot start with an underscore.

data.image_name: Image name (used to reference this image on tiles)
data.image_base64: Base64 image string (paste from OXRS Asset Generator)

delete_background_image.title: Delete a background image
delete_background_image.description: Choose an image to remove from the shared library. Any tile still referencing it (on any panel) will simply stop receiving it next time that panel's configuration is pushed.

add_custom_icon.title: Add custom icon
add_custom_icon.description: Generate a base64 PNG using the OXRS Asset Generator at https://oxrs.io/tools/asset-generator.html (change addImage to addIcon in its output) then paste the imageBase64 value below. This icon becomes available on every configured panel, grouped by category in the icon picker. Icons must be PNG, under 4 KB, and names cannot start with an underscore.

data.icon_name: Icon name (used to reference this icon on tiles)
data.icon_base64: Base64 PNG string (paste from OXRS Asset Generator)

delete_custom_icon.title: Delete a custom icon
delete_custom_icon.description: Choose an icon to remove from the shared library.

album_art_settings.title: Album art
album_art_settings.description: Album art is shrunk to fit one MQTT message ({default} bytes by default, the largest size measured working on real hardware) and drawn at {size} px on a single tile. On a tile bigger than one cell the panel enlarges a small image, so the image stays small however big the tile is.

data.album_art_text: Draw title and artist on big tiles

data_description.album_art_zoom: How much the panel enlarges the picture on a tile bigger than 1 × 1 (100 to 200). Higher uploads a smaller image, which looks blockier.
data_description.album_art_max_source: The longest edge of the image sent for a big tile. Raising it gives a sharper picture but needs more of the panel's memory. A panel sent an image it cannot hold may crash, and album art is re-sent every time it reconnects, so raise it only after testing.
data_description.album_art_text: Adds the track title and artist to the picture on tiles of at least 2 × 2, where the firmware's own text would be tiny.

panel_settings.title: Panel display settings
panel_settings.description: The panel's own sleep, brightness, reporting and colour settings, pre-filled with the firmware defaults and pushed to the panel each time it connects. A timeout of 0 disables that timeout, so a panel left on the defaults never turns its screen off.

data_description.noActivitySecondsToSleep: Turn the screen backlight off after this long without a touch (0 disables, up to 3600). A touch wakes it.
data_description.noActivitySecondsToHome: Return to the home screen after this long without a touch (0 disables, up to 600).
data_description.noActivitySecondsToLock: Lock the panel behind its PIN keypad after this long without a touch (0 disables, up to 3600).
data_description.tileBrightnessOn: Brightness of tiles in their on state (75 to 100).
data_description.tileBrightnessOff: Brightness of tiles in their off state (0 to 25).
data_description.climateUpdateSeconds: How often the panel reads and reports its temperature and humidity sensors (0 stops the reports, up to 86400).
data_description.background_color: Colour of every screen and tile background (default black). A screen or tile with its own colour keeps it.
data_description.icon_on_color: Colour of icons on tiles that are on (default light green). Black is read by the firmware as unset and gives the default.

abort.no_tiles: There are no tiles to remove.
abort.screen_full: That screen has no free tile positions. Choose another screen or remove a tile first.
abort.invalid_tile_style: Please select a valid tile style.

abort.invalid_details: Error setting tile details. Check the logs for details.
abort.no_file: Please paste the base64 image string.
abort.image_error: Invalid base64 string. Copy the imageBase64 value from the OXRS Asset Generator output.
abort.image_too_large: Image is larger than 64 KB. Resize it first - the OXRS docs call ~4 KB safe, and larger images may not draw at all.
abort.invalid_image_name: Image name cannot start with an underscore.
abort.image_uploaded: Background image saved to the shared library - available on every panel!
abort.no_screens: No screens exist yet — add a tile first.
abort.image_deleted: Background image deleted from the shared library.
abort.no_images: There are no background images in the shared library yet.
abort.icon_uploaded: Custom icon saved to the shared library - available on every panel!
abort.icon_deleted: Custom icon deleted from the shared library.
abort.no_icons: There are no custom icons in the shared library yet.
abort.music_assistant_unavailable: Couldn't read the Music Assistant library for this player. Check that Music Assistant is running, then try again.
abort.no_playlists: The Music Assistant library has no playlists yet. Add some in Music Assistant, then try again.
abort.no_editable_tiles: There are no tiles that can be edited yet - add one first.

error.image_error: Invalid base64 string. Copy the imageBase64 value from the OXRS Asset Generator output.
error.image_too_large: Too large - the encoded string must stay under 64 KB. The OXRS docs call ~4 KB safe; above that the panel may ignore the image or restart.
error.invalid_image_name: Name cannot start with an underscore (reserved for built-ins).
error.icon_must_be_png: Custom icons must be PNG format.
error.no_larger_size: No larger size fits at that position. Choose another position, or make room first.
